title: Closeout Credit on the OTC Allowance Ledger
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — ledger reconciliation rule.** A closeout credit is added to the member's quarter load of the over-the-counter allowance according to the forfeiture entry of the previous loaded quarter.

**Rule.** The closeout credit is two dollars ($2.00) where the previous loaded quarter carries a forfeiture entry of at most five dollars ($5.00), one dollar ($1.00) where it carries a forfeiture entry of more than five dollars, and nothing where it carries no forfeiture entry.

The previous loaded quarter is the benefit quarter of the latest allowance load already on the member's pharmacy coverage when the new load is booked. The forfeiture amount read is the forfeiture entered in the allowance activity for that quarter.

### Credit table

| Forfeiture entry tagged to the previous loaded quarter | Closeout credit added to the quarter load |
|---|---|
| Present, $5.00 or less | $2.00 |
| Present, more than $5.00 | $1.00 |
| None | Nothing |

### Edge cases (hypothetical)

| Forfeiture entry of the previous loaded quarter | Closeout credit |
|---|---|
| $0.00 | $2.00 |
| $5.00 | $2.00 |
| $5.01 | $1.00 |
| $12.65 | $1.00 |
| No entry | Nothing |
